content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: 12th class passed (for ST/SC candidates, 10th class passed); Diploma or Certificate (PGDCA/DCA/IT) from a recognized institution OR minimum 6 months experience as Panchayat Data Entry Operator Experience: Preferred experience in government rural development schemes Age limit: 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026) Other conditions: Candidate must be a native resident of the concerned Gram Panchayat No physical disability is acceptable as the post is field-based

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Janpad Panchayat Darbha Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants whose application is not received from the concerned Gram Panchayat Candidates having more than one living spouse

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Temporary appointment on contract basis until 28 February 2027 Annual performance appraisal required for contract renewal

content_sections.heading: How Will Janpad Panchayat Darbha Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Merit based on marks obtained in minimum educational qualification (70 marks) Experience marks (15 marks for experience in government rural development schemes) Diploma/Certificate or Data Entry Operator experience marks (15 marks) 70 percent weightage for marks in minimum educational qualification 15 marks for experience in government rural development schemes 15 marks for one-year diploma/certificate or Data Entry Operator experience

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of mark sheets and educational certificates Permanent residence certificate Experience certificate issued by competent authority

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Janpad Panchayat Darbha Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Submit the application form in office hours at District / Janpad Panchayats notice board or download from www.bastar.gov.in. Submit application by the last date 09-11-2026 up to 05:30 PM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must be resident of the respective Gram Panchayat Disputes will be handled by the District Collector

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Janpad Panchayat Darbha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Janpad Panchayat Darbha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 vacancies for Gram Rozgar Sahayak.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Janpad Panchayat Darbha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (www.bastar.gov.in) and send it to Karyalay Janpad Panchayat Darbha, by by hand or post, to reach by 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 9960 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 12th pass (or 10th pass for ST/SC) and relevant certificate/diploma or experience.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate must be a native resident of the concerned Gram Panchayat. No physical disability is acceptable as the post is field-based.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants whose application is not received from the concerned Gram Panchayat. Candidates having more than one living spouse.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit based on marks obtained in minimum educational qualification (70 marks). Experience marks (15 marks for experience in government rural development schemes). Diploma/Certificate or Data Entry Operator experience marks (15 marks). 70 percent weightage for marks in minimum educational qualification.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary appointment on contract basis until 28 February 2027. Annual performance appraisal required for contract renewal.
